normalized_matching_profile.name: WaterColor 36 Inkberry Street
normalized_matching_profile.description: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Per WaterColor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 12 wristbands.- 4 adult bikes- 6 Passenger Low-Speed Vehicle- Fabulous Outdoor Space- Wolf Sub-Zero Appliances in Kitchen- Screened Porch on first level with outdoor fireplace - Propane Grill - 14' Ceilings- SONOS Sound System- Basketball Hoop - This property comes with 3 dedicated parking spots. - Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutGuests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, as well an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: Live in the Watercolor experience at 36 Inkberry Street, a 3,300 sq. foot 2-story home in Watercolor's Lake District overlooking Long Leaf Park. Set in a spacious home that sleeps 12, this 4 bedroom, 4.5 bath beach house feels like a private getaway, but its location near Watercolor's Frog Pool means it's close to shopping, dining, and 30A's best beaches. Upon entering, you will notice that the generous windows and doors allow for natural sunlight to flood into the house, complementing the soft blue hues and natural branch fixtures. Guests will also find an open concept kitchen and living area, a spacious screened-in porch complete with fireplace for outdoor family gatherings, and two of the four bedrooms located on the first floor. Upstairs, there is one additional guest bedroom and the Primary bedroom. Jump on one of the four bikes to explore WaterColor's winding roads and famous community pools or lounge on the front porch while watching your family play at the park across the street! If quintessential 30A is what you're looking for, 36 Inkberry is sure to meet all expectations and then some! SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS:FIRST FLOOR: - Guest Bedroom: Two Twin Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Primary Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with ShowerSECOND FLOOR: - Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Separate Shower and Tub- Guest Bedroom: King Bed with built in bunk room with 2 Twin over Twin Bunk Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower onlyWATERCOLOR NEIGHBORHOOD HIGHLIGHTS: - Named the #1 family vacation destination in the U.S.- A 499 acre coastal resort and residential community- Ideal bike community perfect for family getaways- Pristine sugar sand beaches- 4 swimming pools - Award-winning tennis facilities- Championship golf nearby- World Famous Beach Club- Unparalleled beachside, poolside and lakeside dining- Acres of parks, gardens and foot paths- Nearby state parks and preservesWeddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments as well as be subject to HOA, community and 360 Blue fines.Please note: Effective March 15, 2014, golf cart rentals in WaterColor must be made through The Electric Cart Company and will be limited to 80 vehicles throughout the community at any given time. Only one cart may be rented per home and rentals will be granted on a first-come, first-served basis.
